panel.title: Correlation 1 — Brute Force Then Successful Login (T1110 + T1078)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4624) | stats count(eval(EventCode="4625")) as failed_count, count(eval(EventCode="4624")) as success_count by Account_Name, ComputerName | where failed_count >= 3 AND success_count >= 1 | eval risk="HIGH — Possible Brute Force Success" | table Account_Name, ComputerName, failed_count, success_count, risk | sort -failed_count

panel.title: Correlation 2 — Backdoor Account + Admin Escalation (T1136 + T1098)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4732) | stats count(eval(EventCode="4720")) as new_user, count(eval(EventCode="4732")) as added_to_admin by Account_Name, ComputerName | where new_user >= 1 AND added_to_admin >= 1 | eval risk="CRITICAL — Backdoor Admin Account Created" | table Account_Name, ComputerName, new_user, added_to_admin, risk

panel.title: Correlation 3 — Attack Then Evidence Destruction (T1110 + T1070)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=1102) | stats count(eval(EventCode="4625")) as failed_logins, count(eval(EventCode="1102")) as logs_cleared by Account_Name, ComputerName | where failed_logins >= 3 AND logs_cleared >= 1 | eval risk="CRITICAL — Attack Then Evidence Destroyed" | table Account_Name, ComputerName, failed_logins, logs_cleared, risk

panel.title: Lab 12 — Port Scan: Top Destination Ports Hit

search.query: index=main sourcetype="firewall_log" | rex field=_raw "(?P<action>\w+)\s+(?P<protocol>\w+)\s+(?P<src_ip>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<dst_ip>[\d.]+)\s+(?P<src_port>\d+)\s+(?P<dst_port>\d+)" | stats count by dst_port | sort -count | head 15
index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-DNS-Client/Operational" | rex field=_raw "(?P<domain>[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,})" | stats count by domain | sort -count | head 15

panel.title: Suspicious DNS Queries — Sc 04 Data Exfil + Sc 14 C2

search.query: index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4688 New_Process_Name="*nslookup*" | rex field=Process_Command_Line "nslookup\s+(?P<queried_domain>\S+)" | where isnotnull(queried_domain) | stats count by queried_domain, Account_Name | eval suspicious=if(match(queried_domain,"(?i)exfil|attacker|c2-|checkin|chunk"),"SUSPICIOUS","Benign") | sort -count | table queried_domain, Account_Name, count, suspicious
